finding.title: Beta 1 Windows binaries are unsigned and no production signing identity is available
finding.scope_of_block: Blocks claiming signed Windows distribution and should be resolved before a future stable/production-ready Windows release. Beta 1 already discloses this state and remains immutable.
finding.evidence: Both independent Windows signature mechanisms report no signature. Certificate inventory found no code-signing certificate in CurrentUser/My or LocalMachine/My.
finding.documentation: README.md:133, README.md:171, README.md:259, packaging/README.txt:23-24, and docs/release-notes-4.0.0-b1.md:59 disclose that the beta is unsigned.

future_signing_gate.requirement: Select and approve a publicly trusted production code-signing identity or managed signing service. Keep private key material in an HSM/service boundary; do not store a PFX or password in Git or ordinary Actions secrets.

Use a protected, manually approved release environment. If the selected signing service supports GitHub OIDC, grant id-token:write only to the signing job and bind trust to the repository, reviewed workflow, tag, and environment.

Build from the reviewed immutable tag. Sign ARX.exe before creating the portable ZIP and installer, then sign the completed installer. Use SHA-256 file and digest algorithms plus an approved RFC 3161 timestamp service.

Verify each signed PE independently with Get-AuthenticodeSignature and signtool verify /pa /all /tw. Require the intended publisher identity, a trusted chain, a valid timestamp, and zero verification errors.
Run malware, package-content, secret, identity, and installer smoke checks after signing. Generate final checksums only after all signing operations are complete.

Create OIDC-backed artifact provenance for the final wheel, sdist, portable ZIP, installer, checksum manifest, and associated SBOM. Human approval remains required before public attachment or publication.
Exercise signing only on future release candidates or disposable test binaries. Never sign, replace, or relabel the published Beta 1 artifacts.
